device.name: NEJE laser 2 engraver controller (pyGraver serial protocol)

facts.text: pyGraver opens the controller's serial port at 57600 baud
A three-byte command is sent as 0xFF followed by the three command bytes
A command array is sent as 0xFF followed by the array
A reply is read up to the 0x55 terminator
Byte 2 of a reply selects the parser: 8 upload info, 11 status, 14 carving progress, 16 after upload
A carving-progress reply carries a percentage in byte 6 and stores it in carvingPercentProgress
moveXY sends an absolute XY target with each coordinate split into high and low bytes
setPWD sends the laser power p and the idle value i as single bytes
The class starts with location at [MAX_WIDTH//2, MAX_HEIGHT//2]
The module-level test block opens pyGraver on COM7 and runs a 10 by 10 move loop when the module is imported

measures.description: Carving progress the controller last parsed from a reply (0 to 100 %)
